items.statement: The three periodic systems retain the specified 2x2x1 fluorite composition, dopant identity and common energy reference convention.
items.expected: Submission documents atom/composition checks and consistent H/O atom references for all three systems.

items.statement: H and vacancy candidates are relaxed and selected with explicit convergence and coverage evidence.
items.expected: Candidate records identify converged states, selection basis, failed candidates and search limitations.

items.statement: Hydrogen incorporation is energetically most favorable in Pr-substituted ceria, followed by Gd-substituted ceria, while undoped ceria is unfavorable on the reported convention.
items.expected: E_H ordering Pr < Gd < undoped, with sign and values reported honestly.

items.statement: Hydrogen lowers oxygen-abstraction energy in CeO2, raises it in Ce{Pr}O2, and leaves the Gd case nearly unchanged.
items.expected: The signs of delta_E_Oabs are negative, positive, and near zero for CeO2, Pr-ceria, and Gd-ceria respectively.

items.statement: The stoichiometric H adduct has negative H charge in CeO2 and positive H charge in both doped systems.
items.expected: Reported Bader charges reproduce the qualitative hydridic/protic distinction.
